_meta.rule: A public venue is publishable only after source-backed identity confirmation. Price, hours and family amenities are shown as facts only when separately evidenced on the audited source.
_meta.dynamic_fields_policy: Price/hours are exact only for manually reviewed sources; other stored values remain internal estimates and must not render as verified facts.
_meta.field_level_evidence: verified_fields now carry field_sources; dynamic fields use their exact official tariff/visitor/contact page when available.
